axis_prompt: Rereadability: the post rewards a second pass — depth layered beneath the surface reading, structure that yields more on return, an essay that grows with its reader.
Estimate what a reader gains from a second full read relative to the first; posts that pay near-first-read dividends again score highest.
Ten years from now, a reader returns to this post knowing much more than today; does it hold new things for that stronger reader?
Audit for one-pass exhaustion: prose fully consumed on first contact, with apparent depth that is really restatement.
Seed quality: the comment plants something that grows — a question, observation, or half-idea that later work by others visibly builds on.
Trace what could sprout from this comment: essays it prompts, experiments it suggests, threads it spawns; rate the germination potential.
If one comment in this thread ends up cited in a post a year later, is it this one?
Audit for false fertility: provocative-sounding fragments that invite responses but contain nothing to build on.
Proposal as evidence: the document itself demonstrates the qualities the project will need — clear thinking, honest accounting, and craftsmanship visible in the artifact you are reading.
Treat the proposal's own quality as a work sample: does the rigor on this page predict the rigor of the funded work?
If everything you knew about this team were this document alone, what would you conclude about how they will execute?
Audit for polish-substance divergence: professional formatting and fluent prose wrapped around thin thinking — or rough prose hiding excellent thinking.
